$Comment: The creatures Hallow's Eve brings out at night, the Jack Archers that rise beside the Jack Skeletons on the Headless Horseman's hard ride, and the Pumpkin Fiend Hatchlings his pumpkins hatch in his fight on either ride (Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling and, on the hard ride, Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling_HM). The Hallowed reputation's (Hallows_Eve_Hallowed) Kills table (ZiggfreedCommon/Reputations/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json) pays favor for each one put down. No reputation group names this group, so it changes nothing about how they treat a player. Add a role id here, written *<id>, and its kills count too. Each role id is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role, while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
